title: perideridia simplex
intro: Perideridia simplex, commonly known as Western yam, is a perennial plant native to the western regions of North America. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Perideridia simplex include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may contribute to its ability to soothe skin irritations and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
